registrar_questions: Rule K: a diagnosis that names NUT carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma together. Record 8023/3 (the WHO entity includes squamous features, so one code covers every term), or the numerically higher 8070/3 to 8072/3? This evidence recommends 8023/3.

A histology report that names only a poorly differentiated carcinoma but states nuclear NUT staining in more than 50% of tumour cells: may the tool record 8023/3 at basis 7 when the diagnosis line does not name NUT carcinoma, including when a NUTM1 FISH test is negative? Luo gives the stain 100% specificity in a carcinoma; Lemelle calls the molecular test definitive; Luo cites a false-negative FISH case.
